'''FC Winterthur''' is a Swiss [[association football|football club]] based in [[Winterthur]], [[Canton of Zürich]]. They play in the [[Swiss Challenge League]], the [[Swiss football league system|second tier]] of Swiss football, and appeared regularly in the [[Swiss Super League|Nationalliga A]] during the 20th century. Their home is the [[Schützenwiese Stadium|Stadion Schützenwiese]]."}}
